verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents each part of the story as its own capability. Reverse ETL sources sync data from the warehouse, Profiles turns version-controlled YAML into warehouse-native SQL models, and Audiences are built on warehouse sources and activated downstream to 200+ tools, with an API to run Reverse ETL syncs programmatically. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of audience definition and sync modes beyond feature-index blurbs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse-native activation.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run warehouse-native: define models and audiences on tables already in my warehouse and activate them without re-collecting the data (reverse ETL)

citations.quote: Reverse ETL Sources Sync data from your warehouse, data lake, or database
Audiences Build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them downstream

you declare entities and their attributes in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, incremental computation, and feature aggregation automatically.
Programmatically run syncs for a Reverse ETL connection
Quickly set up and monitor pipelines from your warehouse or data lake directly to over 200 SaaS tools.
Push your customer 360 to business tools or access it through a real-time API.
